commands: python3 experiments/datasets/snapshot_dataset.py snapshot --version-id v1 --parent-version  --description "Initial 129-session FAITHFUL+PARTIAL keep-set; flailing retained and tagged" --working-csv experiment/working_dataset.csv --faithfulness-json experiment/faithfulness_full_pool.json --human-labels experiment/faithfulness_human_label_sheet.csv --judge-version judge_v1_75pct --curation-rules "FAITHFUL+PARTIAL kept; flailing RETAINED tagged FLAILING_SUSPECT; sparse kept; nothing gated on category count or graph viability" --retain-flailing

known_limitations: Faithfulness judge at 75% collapsed agreement with 20-session human validation (below 90% threshold).

meaningful_event_count and Frida category counts are descriptive only, not inclusion gates.
